import json, tempfile, os
from pathlib import Path
from codex_harness.adapters.record_references import artifact_references
from codex_harness.adapters.artifacts import FileArtifacts
from codex_harness.adapters.maintenance import ArtifactMaintenance
from codex_harness.adapters.store import MemoryStore
r='sha256:'+'1'*64
cases = {
'duplicate_image': {'stdout': '{\"candidate\":{},\"image\":\"'+r+'\",\"image\":\"unknown\"}'},
'invalid_context': {'image':r, 'checks':None},
'unknown_inspect_flag': {'argv':['docker','inspect','container','--unknown','--format','{{.Image}}'],'stdout':r},
}
for name, value in cases.items(): print(name, json.dumps(value), sorted(artifact_references(value)))
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir='.') as temp:
    artifacts=FileArtifacts(str(Path(temp)/'artifacts')); store=MemoryStore()
    child=artifacts.put('required historical evidence','review-fixture')['ref']
    malformed={'stdout':'{\"candidate\":{},\"image\":\"'+child+'\",\"image\":\"unknown\"}'}
    parent=artifacts.put(json.dumps(malformed),'review-fixture')['ref']
    with store.transaction() as tx: tx.put('reviews','retained',{'evidence_ref':parent})
    os.utime(artifacts.root/(child[7:]+'.txt'),(1,1))
    result=ArtifactMaintenance(store,artifacts).collect(apply=True)
    print('GC_REPRO', json.dumps({'result':result,'parent_exists':(artifacts.root/(parent[7:]+'.txt')).exists(),'child_exists':(artifacts.root/(child[7:]+'.txt')).exists()}))
PY"
